Rat Claw.description: A sharp, dirty claw taken from a Hollow Rat. Brittle, but useful in crude crafting.

Rat Hide.description: A patch of rough hide stripped from a Hollow Rat. Thin, flexible, and surprisingly durable.

Cracked Iron Shard.description: A fractured piece of iron plating. Damaged, but still usable as scrap metal.

Core Fragment.description: A faintly warm fragment taken from the core of a Cracked Sentinel. Weak energy still pulses inside.

Wailer Essence.description: A cold, unstable essence left behind by a Wailer. It seems to shift when viewed directly.

Wailer Talon.description: A long curved talon with an unnaturally sharp edge. The surface is cold to the touch.

Crawler Fang.description: A heavy fang from a Blackwater Crawler. Its serrated edge remains dangerous even after removal.

Blackwater Carapace.description: A thick plate of dark shell from a Blackwater Crawler. Hard enough to turn aside weak blades.

Deep Stalker Fang.description: A narrow fang taken from a Deep Stalker. Its point is fine enough to pierce leather with ease.

Fungal Fiber.description: Tough strands harvested from Underdark fungus. Flexible fibers like these can be woven or bound together.

Glowcap Spore.description: A faintly glowing fungal spore. It releases a soft blue light when disturbed.

Darksteel Scrap.description: A dense piece of dark metal scarred by countless impacts. Even damaged, it is unusually strong.

Deep Whisperer Brain.description: The preserved brain of a Deep Whisperer. Strange pulses move through the tissue long after death.

Fish Scale.description: A broad, reflective scale from an underground fish. Flexible, waterproof, and tougher than it appears.
